SELECT project_id AS projectId, title AS title, project_status AS projectStatus, deadline_date AS deadlineDate, applicant_count AS applicantCount, created_at AS createdAt FROM projects WHERE client_id = #{clientId}
AND project_status = 'READY'
AND project_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
AND project_status = 'CLOSED'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
